verdict.rationale: RevenueCat confirms a REST API secured by API keys (revenuecat-docs-5) and even offers an MCP server letting AI assistants manage subscriptions programmatically (revenuecat-docs-9) and an AI toolkit (revenuecat-docs-8), showing real support for AI-driven API access. However, probes for a public OpenAPI/swagger spec or docs.md all 404 (revenuecat-probe-2, revenuecat-probe-3), so a fully documented, discoverable public API reference isn't evidenced. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference spec, broader REST endpoint documentation beyond auth, and independent confirmation of programmatic API usage outside RevenueCat's own docs.
